question:
'A # B' means 'A is the husband of B'

'A @ B' means 'A is the wife of B'

'A & B' means 'A is the mother of B'

'A % B' means 'A is the father of B'

If 'J @ I % H # G & F', then how is I related to F?

Given: ‘**J @ I % H # G & F**’

1) J @ I 

'J @ I’ means 'J is the wife of I'.

2) I % H

'I % H' means 'I is father of H'.

3) H # G

'H # G' means 'H is husband of G'.

4) G & F

'G & F' means 'G is mother of F'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5832c050a0e2bdb48c8518cd56eefcde754c38c227959e84b81a2f9dde968f68.png] 

Hence, I is the '**Father's father**' of F.
